title: The Chief drains heavy work for another project's quiet window and resumes it
description: graphyard master drain REASON lets a running trial finish while new merge trials, declared checks, host worker verification and session suites wait, and the loop keeps cycling and reporting (the batch gate runs on, GY-3450); a restart keeps the drain with its reason and requester, and master resume admits the waiting jobs with every gate they had.
